text:
jlee: FYI ran a RoPE-scaling sweep this morning across Mistral-7B, Mixtral-7B, and Qwen-7B.
anita: what's the exact setup / variants you tried?
jlee: short config snippet:
```yaml
rope_variant: ntk
scale: [1.0,1.25,1.5,2.0]
max_seq: [2048,4096,8192]
kv_dtype: fp16
batcher: dynamic_approx
kernel_policy: auto (flash_attn preferred)
```
carlos: results?
jlee: TL;DR:
- Mistral: linear scaling OK up to ~4k, >4k NTK gives better perplexity but latency increases ~8-12%
- Mixtral: NTK at ~1.25 best stability at 6k, linear showed hallucination spikes
- Qwen: YARN scaling required beyond ~3k, NTK caused token misalignment on some prompts
emma: can you paste perf numbers?
jlee: perf table (rough P95 throughput tok/s):
```text
Mistral-7B (linear 1.0 @2k): 120 tok/s
Mistral-7B (linear 2.0 @8k): 98 tok/s (+18% cpu)
Mistral-7B (ntk 1.5 @8k): 88 tok/s (+10% quality)
Mixtral-7B (linear 1.0 @4k): 110 tok/s
Mixtral-7B (ntk 1.25 @6k): 102 tok/s (stable)
Qwen-7B (yarn 1.2 @4k): 95 tok/s (best quality)
```
anita: what about KV cache behavior during dynamic batching?
jlee: saw KV fragmentation with Mixtral+NTK under dynamic_approx batcher. KV cache growth spikes when batches mix short+very-long; repro below:
```bash
# reproduction
python -m bench.gen --model mixtral-7b --rope ntk --seq 6144 --batcher dynamic_approx
```
carlos: kernel selection impact?
jlee: flash_attn saved ~15% p95 on Mistral linear but it crashed with Mixtral+NTK at 8k due to smem limit -> fallback to cutlass increased latency ~30%. Need kernel guardrails and memory checks.
infra-bot: deploy-canary: rope-ntk-1.25 added to canary pool (id: rope-2026-03-18-03)
emma: any quality metrics (perplexity / QA regressions)?
jlee: perplexity deltas vs baseline:
- Mistral linear@8k: +0.06 ppl (negligible)
- Mistral ntk@8k: -0.12 ppl (improved)
- Mixtral linear@6k: +0.30 ppl (regression, observed hallucinations)
- Mixtral ntk@6k: -0.20 ppl (regained quality)
- Qwen yarn@4k: ~baseline
anita: recommendations?
jlee: actionable items:
- Mistral: default=linear up to 4k, enable NTK for 4k-8k with pinned flash_attn mem-checks
- Mixtral: prefer NTK ~1.25 for >4k, but add KV defrag in batcher and force safe cutlass fallback on smem errors
- Qwen: enable YARN scaling for >3k only; avoid NTK unless we add token-alignment tests
- Add perf-regression alerting: p95 +10% or quality delta >0.15 ppl
- Add a small canary suite (2k/4k/8k across models + kernel permutations)
carlos: will add canary tests to eng-runtime CI and pin kernel policies in infra config. :+1:
anita: can we also get flamegraphs / profiles for the bad cases?
jlee: uploaded flamegraph and perf traces to S3: s3://redwood-perf/rope/1757831234-flame.svg :eyes:
emma: i'll draft a rollout plan + one-pager for product impact and share in #product after review.
jlee: will open a PR with pinned kernel rules and KV-defrag patch, and attach benchmark scripts.
carlos: quick follow-up: i suggest adding a short synthetic workload to the autoscaler tests so batcher patterns don't regress.
emma: agreed. thanks everyone.
jlee: thanks — next step: canary the ntk variants for Mixtral and Mistral, monitor p95 + perplexity over 48h.
